components.css: .ds-cell-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #222831); border-radius: 0; background: var(--cyan, #00adb5); color: var(--ink, #222831); font: 600 1rem/1 'Inter Variable', 'Noto Sans Thai', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.005em; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color .25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cell-cta svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cell-cta:hover { background: var(--ink, #222831); color: var(--cyan, #00adb5); } .ds-cell-cta:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-cell-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #222831); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-cell-cta:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Sheet Band

components.css: .ds-sheet-band { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 84px 1fr auto; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #222831); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(34,40,49,.42); font: 400 .75rem/1.4 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #222831); background: var(--film, #eeeeee); } .ds-sheet-band > span { padding: 10px 14px; } .ds-band-no { padding-left: 0 !important; border-right: 1px solid rgba(34,40,49,.42); font-weight: 500; } .ds-band-meta { color: #575d66; border-left: 1px solid rgba(34,40,49,.42); }

components.name: Title Block

components.css: .ds-title-block { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr 120px 120px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #222831); background: rgba(255,255,255,.5); font: 400 .8rem/1.4 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #222831); } .ds-title-block > span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 10px 14px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(34,40,49,.42); } .ds-title-block > span:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-title-block small { font-size: .65rem; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #575d66; }

components.name: Request Cell (input)

components.css: .ds-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 12px 18px 10px; background: var(--paper, #ffffff); border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #222831); transition: box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cell > span { font: 400 .72rem/1.4 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .03em; color: #575d66; } .ds-cell input { width: 100%; padding: 6px 0 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; outline: none; font: 400 1.02rem/1.5 'Inter Variable', 'Noto Sans Thai', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #222831); } .ds-cell input::placeholder { color: #575d66; } .ds-cell:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--cyan, #00adb5); } .ds-cell:has(:user-invalid) { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--danger, #a43232); }

components.name: Sheet Index Nav

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--film, #eeeeee); border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #222831); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { margin-right: auto; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.025em; color: var(--ink, #222831); } .ds-brand span { font-weight: 400; color: #393e46; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #393e46; text-decoration: underline transparent; text-underline-offset: 8px; text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; transition: color .2s, text-decoration-color .2s; } .ds-nav a small { font: .7rem 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: #575d66; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink, #222831); text-decoration-color: var(--ink, #222831); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-lang:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #222831); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-lang { width: 42px; height: 40px; margin-left: 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #222831); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; font: 500 .8rem 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink, #222831); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-lang:hover { background: var(--ink, #222831); color: var(--film, #eeeeee); }

components.css: .ds-legend { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font: 400 .78rem/1.4 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: #393e46; } .ds-legend li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-key { display: inline-block; width: 32px; height: 0; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #222831); } .ds-key.ds-dashed { border-top-style: dashed; border-color: #393e46; } .ds-key.ds-double { border-top: 5px double var(--ink, #222831); } .ds-live { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; margin: 0 11px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan, #00adb5); } .ds-live::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -5px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--cyan, #00adb5); animation: ds-live 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-live { 0% { transform: scale(.4); opacity: .9; } 100% { transform: scale(1.6); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-live::after { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The site is a construction drawing set. A visitor's workflow is surveyed as-is in dashed line (Excel, LINE, paper), redrawn as-built in solid line, and CondoMate is the built sheet, printed in reverse on a charcoal "night print". Every section is a numbered sheet (A-00 to A-06) opened by a title-block band; the hero closes with a full title block (sheet, title, scale, year); the footer is the master title block. Nothing is a card, nothing glows, nothing floats. Structure comes from ruled lines, cells and dimension marks on a drafting-film ground with a fine 24px/120px grid.

Density is a working drawing's: generous sheet spacing (72 to 136px between sheets) with tight, ruled detail inside each sheet (schedules, numbered notes, request form cells). Ink is charcoal, secondary line is graphite, and one colour, Cero Cyan, is held back for the things a visitor can act on and the things that are live. The world explicitly refuses the dark SaaS hero, the feature-card grid and the glowing "0" ring of the previous site.

Motion is plotting, not presenting: lines draw, dashes resolve to solid, a process line is ruled in as you read. Every drawing's default state is the finished, visible drawing; motion only animates from blank toward it, so a stalled script or reduced motion still shows the whole set.
keyCharacteristics: Line form carries state: dashed = today's manual workflow, solid = built, double = management/live console.
Cero Cyan only on actions (primary cells, focus underline in fields, selection) and live state (the live dot).
Numbered sheets A-00 to A-06, each opened by a mono title-block band; no eyebrows above headings.
Square, ruled, flat: 0 radius everywhere except real device screenshots and node/live dots.
Thai first: Thai copy sets in Noto Sans Thai with looser leading; Thai labels are never tracked or uppercased.
Motion = plot/draw from an already-visible default; one pinned CondoMate stage; reduced motion disables Lenis and the pin.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Cero Cyan appears only on something you can press or something that is live. If it is neither, it is ink or graphite.

rules.name: The Night Print Rule
rules.body: The reversed charcoal ground is reserved for the built product (CondoMate) and the master title block (footer). Other sheets stay on film.

rules.name: The Thai Face Rule
rules.body: Any label set in mono for English switches to Noto Sans Thai in Thai, with letter-spacing 0 and no text-transform. Geist Mono has no Thai glyphs; tracked or uppercased Thai is never acceptable.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings are introduced by the sheet's title-block band, not by a kicker line above them. A heading stands alone with its lede beside or below it.

rules.name: The Line Weight Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand out, give it a heavier or different line, not a shadow, glow or tint.

dos: Do encode state in line form: dashed for today's manual workflow, solid for what is built, double for the management/live console.
Do keep Cero Cyan to actions and live state, with Charcoal Ink text on cyan fills.
Do open every sheet with its numbered title-block band (A-00 to A-06) and let the heading stand without a kicker.
Do set Thai in Noto Sans Thai with leading of 1.75 for body and 1.24 to 1.3 for headings, and switch mono labels to the Thai face with zero tracking and no uppercase.
Do keep every control and container square (0 radius) with a ruled border; reserve curves for devices, nodes and dots.
Do animate by plotting: stroke-dashoffset draws, dashed-to-solid rules, leader lines extending, always from a default state that already shows the finished drawing.
Do keep a single pinned stage (CondoMate) and drop Lenis and the pin entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use real CondoMate screens with dimension marks as proof; label them, never mock them up.
donts: Don't use cyan for decoration, headings, icons, borders of non-actions or background washes.
Don't put an eyebrow or kicker line above a heading.
Don't track or uppercase Thai, or set Thai in Geist Mono.
Don't build feature-card grids, rounded cards, pills, glows or gradient heroes; use schedules, ruled lists and title-block cells.
Don't add a second pinned or scroll-jacked section.
Don't hide content behind animation: nothing may depend on a script running to become visible.
Don't use shadows for hierarchy; the device drop under real phone screenshots is the only shadow.
